questions.prompt: Do you go to bed early or late?
questions.sampleA2:
I go to bed late, and I watch TV.

I am tired in the morning, but I like the TV.
questions.sampleB1:
I usually go to bed quite late, around 11 pm or midnight.

I think it's because I like to watch TV or read before sleeping.

However, I know it's not very good for me, so I'm trying to go to bed earlier.
questions.sampleB2: To be honest, I'm definitely more of a night owl, so I tend to turn in pretty late, usually around midnight. The thing is, that's when I finally get the chance to unwind and switch off after a hectic day. I know I ought to hit the hay earlier, but old habits die hard.
questions.uzSampleA2:
Men kech yotaman va televizor ko'raman.

Men ertalab charchagan bo'laman, lekin menga televizor yoqadi.
questions.uzSampleB1:
Men odatda kech yotaman, taxminan soat 11 yoki yarim tunda.

Menimcha, buning sababi televizor ko'rishni yoki uxlashdan oldin kitob o'qishni yaxshi ko'raman.

Biroq, bilaman, bu men uchun unchalik yaxshi emas, shuning uchun erta uxlashga harakat qilyapman.
questions.uzSampleB2:
Umuman olganda, men ko'proq tungi odamman, shuning uchun odatda kechroq yotishga harakat qilaman, odatda soat 11:30 yoki yarim tunda.

Bu ideal emasligini bilaman, lekin men shunda eng xotirjam bo'laman va uzoq kundan keyin nihoyat dam olishim mumkin.

Garchi erta uxlashning foydalarini bilsam ham, odatimni o'zgartirishga qiynalaman, ayniqsa dam olish kunlari, ko'pincha undan ham kechgacha uxlamayman.

vocabulary.title: Q1 - Do you go to bed early or late?
idioms: burn the midnight oil - "kechgacha ishlash"
"Hit the hay" - "Uxlashga yotish"
sleep like a log - "qattiq uxlamoq"
sentenceStarters: "Honestly speaking, I tend to be a night owl..." - "Rostini aytsam, men tungi qush bo'lishga moyilman..."
"From my perspective, getting enough sleep is crucial..." - "Mening nuqtai nazarimdan, yetarlicha uxlash juda muhim..."
"I'd have to say that my sleep schedule varies..." - "Shuni aytishim kerakki, uyqu jadvalim turlicha..."

questions.sampleAnswer:
To be perfectly honest, I tend to go to bed rather late, usually around midnight or even later. I've always been a night owl, and I find that I'm most productive during the evening hours.
That said, I fully recognize that this isn't the healthiest habit. I've been trying to wind down earlier and establish a better sleep routine. As they say, "Early to bed and early to rise makes a man healthy, wealthy, and wise."
On weekends, I occasionally stay up even later, especially if I'm watching a good movie or chatting with friends. However, I'm gradually realizing the importance of quality sleep for my overall well-being.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Rostini aytsam, men odatda kech yotishga moyilman, ko'pincha yarim tunda yoki undan ham keyin. Men har doim "tungi boyo'g'li" bo'lganman va kechki payt eng samarali ekanligimni sezaman.

Shunga qaramay, men bu eng sog'lom odat emasligini to'liq tan olaman. Men erta dam olishga va yaxshiroq uyqu rejimini o'rnatishga harakat qilyapman. Aytishlaricha, "Erta yotib, erta turgan odam sog'lom, boy va dono bo'ladi."

Dam olish kunlari men ba'zan undan ham kechgacha uxlamayman, ayniqsa, agar yaxshi kino ko'rayotgan bo'lsam yoki do'stlarim bilan suhbatlashayotgan bo'lsam. Biroq, men asta-sekin umumiy farovonligim uchun sifatli uyquning muhimligini anglamoqdaman.

questions.sampleA1: I have a house. It is small. It is blue. I like my house.
questions.sampleA2: I live in a house. It is not very big, but it's okay. It has a kitchen and a bedroom. I like my house because it is comfortable and I can relax there.
questions.sampleB1: I live in a house with my family. It's a semi-detached house, so we share a wall with our neighbors. We have a small garden, which is nice. I think my house is quite comfortable, although it could be bigger. In my opinion, it's a good place to live.
questions.sampleB2: Well, I live in a fairly modest two-storey house on the outskirts of town, and honestly, it suits us down to the ground. It's nothing fancy, but it's got a cosy feel to it, with a little garden out back where I like to potter about. At the end of the day, there really is no place like home.
questions.uzSampleA1: Mening uyim bor. U kichkina. U ko'k rangda. Menga uyim yoqadi.
questions.uzSampleA2: Men uyda yashayman. U juda katta emas, lekin yaxshi. Unda oshxona va yotoqxona bor. Menga uyim yoqadi, chunki u qulay va men u yerda dam olishim mumkin.
questions.uzSampleB1: Men oilam bilan birga uyda yashayman. Bu qo'shni uy, shuning uchun biz qo'shnilar bilan bir devorni bo'lishamiz. Bizning kichik bog'imiz bor, bu juda yaxshi. Menimcha, uyim juda qulay, garchi u kattaroq bo'lishi mumkin edi. Mening fikrimcha, bu yashash uchun yaxshi joy.
questions.uzSampleB2: Mening uyim tinch, shahar chetidagi mahallada joylashgan ikki qavatli bino. U unchalik zamonaviy emas, lekin o'ziga xos jozibasi bor. Katta bo'lmagan, yaxshi bog' bor, men uni parvarish qilishdan zavqlanaman, garchi bu ancha vaqt talab qilsa ham. Umuman olganda, uyimda yashash qulay va tinch, deb bilaman, garchi har doim qilmoqchi bo'lgan yaxshilanishlarim bo'lsa ham. U albatta uydek tuyuladi.

vocabulary.title: Q2 - Tell me about your house.
idioms: home sweet home - "aziz uyim"
"A man's home is his castle" - "Odamning uyi uning qal'asidir"

sentenceStarters: "Honestly speaking, my home is my sanctuary..." - "Rostini aytsam, uyim mening boshpanangdir..."

questions.sampleAnswer:
I currently live in a cozy apartment located in a residential area of the city. It's a two-bedroom flat on the fourth floor of a modern building, which I've been renting for about three years now.
The apartment is tastefully decorated with a minimalist style. My favorite room is the living room, which has large windows that let in plenty of natural light. I've also set up a small home office in one corner where I work remotely.
One thing I particularly love about my place is the balcony. It offers a stunning view of the neighborhood, and I often enjoy my morning coffee there. As they say, "Home is where the heart is," and I've definitely made this space my own.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Men hozirda shaharning turar joy hududida joylashgan shinam kvartirada yashayman. Bu zamonaviy binoning to'rtinchi qavatida joylashgan ikki xonali uy, men uni taxminan uch yildan beri ijaraga olganman.

Kvartira minimalist uslubda did bilan bezatilgan. Mening eng sevimli xonam - bu mehmonxona, unda ko'p tabiiy yorug'lik tushadigan katta derazalar bor. Men, shuningdek, bir burchakda masofadan turib ishlash uchun kichik uy ofisini tashkil qildim.

Menga uyimning ayniqsa yoqadigan jihati - bu balkon. U qo'shnilarning ajoyib manzaralarini taqdim etadi va men u yerda ko'pincha ertalabki qahvamni ichishdan zavqlanaman. Aytishlaricha, "Uy - bu yurak joylashgan joy", va men bu joyni o'zimga moslashtirganman.

questions.sampleB2: Hands down, my go-to drink has to be a proper cup of green tea. I suppose I got hooked on it a few years back, and now I can't really get going in the morning without one. What I love is how it perks me up gently, without leaving me all jittery the way coffee tends to.
questions.uzSampleA2:
Mening eng sevimli ichimligim apelsin sharbati.

U menga yoqadi, chunki u shirin.

Va men uni ertalab ichaman.
questions.uzSampleB1:
Mening eng sevimli ichimligim, ehtimol, qahva.

Men uni har kuni ichaman, chunki u meni uyg'otish uchun kerak.

Men uni sut va shakar bilan ichishni yaxshi ko'raman.

Menimcha, uning ta'mi juda yaxshi, ayniqsa ertalab.

questions.uzSampleB2:
Agar tanlashga to'g'ri kelsa, mening eng sevimli ichimligim muzli qahva deb aytgan bo'lardim, ayniqsa, iliq oylarda.

Men uni juda tetiklantiruvchi deb bilaman va u menga ko'pincha kerak bo'ladigan energiya beradi, ayniqsa, tushdan keyin.

Men yaxshi issiq qahvani qadrlasam ham, muzli versiyasi boshqacha ta'sir qiladi.

Men, shuningdek, turli xil ta'mlar va qo'shimchalar bilan tajriba o'tkazishni yoqtiraman, masalan, vanil yoki bir chimdim dolchin.

Bu oddiy zavq, lekin men uni chinakam qadrlayman.

vocabulary.title: Q3 - What is your favorite drink?
idioms: not my cup of tea - "menga yoqmaydigan narsa"
"A cup of tea solves everything" - "Bir piyola choy hamma narsani hal qiladi"
spill the tea - "sir aytmoq (slang)"
sentenceStarters: "Honestly speaking, I can't start my day without..." - "Rostini aytsam, kunimni ...siz boshlay olmayman..."
"From my perspective, staying hydrated is important..." - "Mening nuqtai nazarimdan, suv balansini saqlash muhim..."
"I'd have to say that my go-to beverage is..." - "Shuni aytishim kerakki, mening sevimli ichimligim..."

questions.sampleAnswer:
Without a doubt, my all-time favorite drink is green tea. I've been drinking it regularly for several years now, and I genuinely enjoy its subtle flavor and the way it makes me feel refreshed.
What I particularly appreciate about green tea is its health benefits. It's rich in antioxidants and helps me stay focused throughout the day without the jitters that coffee sometimes gives me.
I typically have a cup in the morning and another in the afternoon. It's become a daily ritual that I truly look forward to. As the saying goes, "A cup of tea solves everything," and I wholeheartedly agree with that sentiment.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Shubhasiz, mening eng sevimli ichimligim – ko'k choy. Men uni bir necha yildan beri muntazam ravishda ichib kelaman va uning nozik ta'mi va menga beradigan tetiklik hissini chin dildan yoqtiraman.

Ko'k choyning ayniqsa qadrlaydigan jihatlaridan biri – uning sog'liq uchun foydalari. U antioksidantlarga boy va menga kun davomida qahva ba'zan beradigan asabiylik hissisiz diqqatimni jamlashga yordam beradi.

Odatda, men ertalab bir chashka va kunduzi yana bir chashka ichaman. Bu men chinakam intiqlik bilan kutadigan kundalik odatga aylandi. Aytishlaricha, "Bir chashka choy hamma narsani hal qiladi" va men bu fikrga butunlay qo'shilaman.

questions.prompt: What do you see in these pictures?
questions.sampleA1:
I see food.

One is salad.

One is burger.
questions.sampleA2:
I see two pictures.

One picture has salad, and the woman is eating it.

The other picture has burgers, and people are eating burgers because they are happy.
questions.sampleB1:
In the pictures, I see two different types of food.

The first picture shows a woman eating a salad. I think she is healthy.

The second picture shows some people eating burgers and fries. They look like they are having fun, but it's not very healthy.

So, it's a difference between healthy food and fast food.
questions.sampleB2: So, in these two pictures, there's a striking contrast between healthy eating and fast food. In the first one, a cheerful young woman in a checked shirt is tucking into a fresh salad in her bright kitchen, surrounded by colourful veg like lettuce, carrots and peppers. In the second, three friends are gathered outdoors, laughing away while they munch on burgers and chips. To be honest, both look enjoyable, but the first is all about nourishing your body, whereas the second is more about the social side of grabbing a bite together.
questions.uzSampleA2:
Men ikkita rasm ko'ryapman.

Bir rasmda salat bor va ayol uni yeyapti.

Boshqa rasmda gamburgerlar bor va odamlar gamburger yeyishyapti, chunki ular xursand.
questions.uzSampleB1:
Rasmlarda men ikki xil turdagi ovqatni ko'ryapman.

Birinchi rasmda bir ayol salat yeyayotganini ko'ryapman. Menimcha, u sog'lom.

Ikkinchi rasmda ba'zi odamlar gamburger va kartoshka fri yeyishayapti. Ular xursand bo'lishayotganga o'xshaydi, lekin bu juda sog'lom emas.

Demak, bu sog'lom ovqat va tez tayyorlanadigan ovqat o'rtasidagi farq.
questions.uzSampleB2:
Rasmlar ovqatlanish odatlarida aniq farqni ko'rsatadi.

Birinchi rasmda bir ayol salatdan zavqlanmoqda, bu sog'lom ovqatlanish va yangi ingredientlarga e'tibor qaratilganini ko'rsatadi.

Aksincha, ikkinchi rasmda bir guruh odamlar tez tayyorlanadigan ovqat, xususan, burgerlar iste'mol qilmoqda.

Ular o'zlaridan mamnun ko'rinsalar-da, bu qulaylikning jozibadorligini va ehtimol, kamroq oziqlantiruvchi ovqatni iste'mol qilishning ijtimoiy jihatini ta'kidlaydi.

Bu sog'liqni saqlashga e'tibor berish va darhol qoniqish o'rtasidagi kelishuvni taklif qilganga o'xshaydi.

vocabulary.title: Q4 - What do you see in these pictures?
idioms: you are what you eat - "nima yesang, shunday bo'lasan"
"An apple a day keeps the doctor away" - "Kuniga bitta olma shifokorni uzoqlashtiradi"
junk food - "zararli taom"
sentenceStarters: "In the first picture, I can see..." - "Birinchi rasmda men ... ko'ryapman..."
"The second image shows..." - "Ikkinchi rasm ... ko'rsatmoqda..."

questions.sampleAnswer:
In these two pictures, I can see a striking contrast between healthy eating and fast food consumption.
In the first image, there's a woman who appears to be in her kitchen, enjoying a fresh salad. She's surrounded by colorful vegetables like tomatoes, peppers, and greens. She looks happy and healthy, and her meal clearly represents a nutritious lifestyle. The setting suggests she's made the effort to prepare her own food.
In contrast, the second picture shows a group of young people eating fast food, specifically burgers. They seem to be having fun and socializing, but the food they're consuming is considerably less healthy. One person appears to be laughing, which suggests it's a social gathering.
The images effectively illustrate the dietary choices people make – some prioritize health while others may choose convenience or social enjoyment. It's a thought-provoking comparison about modern eating habits.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Bu ikki suratda men sog‘lom ovqatlanish va tez ovqat iste’mol qilish o‘rtasida yaqqol farqni ko‘rishim mumkin.

Birinchi suratda oshxonada bo‘lib, yangi salatdan bahramand bo‘layotgan ayol tasvirlangan. U pomidor, qalampir va ko‘katlar kabi rang-barang sabzavotlar bilan o‘ralgan. U baxtli va sog‘lom ko‘rinadi va uning taomi aniq oziqlantiruvchi turmush tarzini aks ettiradi. Vaziyat uning o‘z ovqatini tayyorlashga harakat qilganini ko‘rsatadi.

Aksincha, ikkinchi suratda bir guruh yoshlar tez ovqat, xususan, gamburgerlar yeyayotgani ko‘rsatilgan. Ular xursand va muloqotda bo‘lishayotgandek, lekin iste’mol qilayotgan ovqatlari ancha kam foydali. Bir kishi kulayotgandek ko‘rinadi, bu esa ijtimoiy yig‘ilish bo‘layotganini anglatadi.

Suratlar odamlarning ovqatlanish tanlovini samarali tarzda ko‘rsatib beradi – ba’zilar sog‘liqni birinchi o‘ringa qo‘yadi, boshqalari esa qulaylikni yoki ijtimoiy zavqni tanlashi mumkin. Bu zamonaviy ovqatlanish odatlari haqida o‘yga soluvchi taqqoslashdir.

questions.prompt: What benefits can people have by avoiding fast food?
questions.sampleA1: Fast food bad. No fast food good. Healthy. Good.
questions.sampleA2:
Fast food is not good for you.

It has a lot of fat and sugar.

If you don't eat fast food, you can be more healthy and feel better.

And maybe you save money too.
questions.sampleB1:
I think avoiding fast food is a good idea.

For example, it's better for your health because fast food often has a lot of fat and salt.

Also, if you cook at home instead of eating fast food, you can save money.

However, it's sometimes difficult to avoid fast food when you are busy.
questions.sampleB2: Well, cutting out fast food can do you a world of good, to be honest. For starters, you'd steer clear of all that salt and saturated fat, so you'd lower your risk of things like heart disease. On top of that, cooking from scratch at home tends to be far cheaper, so you end up saving a fair bit of money in the long run.
questions.uzSampleA1: Tez ovqat yomon. Tez ovqat yo'q yaxshi. Sog'lom. Yaxshi.
questions.uzSampleA2:
Tez tayyorlanadigan ovqat siz uchun yaxshi emas.

Uning tarkibida yog' va shakar juda ko'p.

Agar siz tez tayyorlanadigan ovqat yemasaningiz, sog'lomroq bo'lishingiz va o'zingizni yaxshiroq his qilishingiz mumkin.

Va balki pulingizni ham tejashingiz mumkin.
questions.uzSampleB1:
Menimcha, tez ovqatdan voz kechish yaxshi fikr.

Masalan, bu sizning sog'lig'ingiz uchun yaxshiroq, chunki tez ovqat ko'pincha ko'p yog' va tuzga ega.

Shuningdek, agar siz tez ovqat yeyish o'rniga uyda ovqat pishirsangiz, pulni tejashingiz mumkin.

Biroq, band bo'lganingizda tez ovqatdan voz kechish ba'zan qiyin.
questions.uzSampleB2:
Tez ovqatni ratsioningizdan chiqarib tashlashning bir nechta afzalliklari bor.

Eng aniqrog'i, jismoniy salomatligingizning yaxshilanishi; tez ovqat odatda zararli yog'lar, qayta ishlangan ingredientlar va haddan tashqari ko'p miqdorda tuz bilan to'ldirilgan bo'lib, bularning barchasi turli xil sog'liq muammolariga olib keladi.

Bundan tashqari, tez ovqatdan doimiy ravishda voz kechish sezilarli moliyaviy tejashga olib kelishi mumkin, chunki uyda ovqat tayyorlash odatda arzonroq.

Yana bir foydasi shundaki, siz ovqatlaringizning ozuqaviy tarkibidan ko'proq xabardor bo'lasiz va umuman olganda sog'lomroq tanlovlar qilish ehtimoli ko'proq.

vocabulary.title: Q5 - What benefits can people have by avoiding fast food?
idioms: prevention is better than cure - "kasallikni davolashdan ko'ra oldini olish yaxshi"
"You are what you eat" - "Nima yesang, shunday bo'lasan"
in the long run - "uzoq muddatda"
sentenceStarters: "From my perspective, the benefits are numerous..." - "Mening nuqtai nazarimdan, foydalari ko'p..."
"I firmly believe that avoiding fast food leads to..." - "Men qat'iy ishonamanki, tez taomdan qochish ...ga olib keladi..."
"There's no denying that healthy eating improves..." - "Sog'lom ovqatlanish ...ni yaxshilashiga shubha yo'q..."

questions.sampleAnswer:
Avoiding fast food can bring numerous benefits to people's lives, both physically and mentally.
Firstly, and most obviously, there are significant health benefits. Fast food is typically high in calories, saturated fats, sodium, and sugar. By avoiding it, people can reduce their risk of obesity, heart disease, diabetes, and high blood pressure. They're likely to have more energy and feel generally healthier.
Secondly, cooking at home instead of eating fast food can lead to financial savings. While fast food may seem cheap, the costs add up over time. Preparing meals at home is considerably more cost-effective in the long run.
Furthermore, avoiding fast food encourages people to develop cooking skills and make more mindful choices about what they eat. This can lead to a greater appreciation for fresh ingredients and balanced nutrition.
Finally, there's the environmental impact. Fast food chains contribute to packaging waste and industrial farming. By avoiding them, we can do our part for the planet.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Tez ovqatdan voz kechish odamlarning hayotiga, ham jismoniy, ham ruhiy jihatdan ko'plab foydalar keltirishi mumkin.

Birinchidan, va eng aniqrog'i, sezilarli sog'liq uchun foydalari bor. Tez ovqat odatda kaloriya, to'yingan yog'lar, natriy va shakar miqdori yuqori bo'ladi. Undan voz kechish orqali odamlar semirish, yurak kasalliklari, diabet va yuqori qon bosimi xavfini kamaytirishi mumkin. Ularning energiyasi ko'proq bo'lishi va o'zlarini umuman sog'lom his qilishlari mumkin.

Ikkinchidan, tez ovqat yeyish o'rniga uyda ovqat tayyorlash moliyaviy tejashga olib kelishi mumkin. Tez ovqat arzon ko'rinishi mumkin bo'lsa-da, xarajatlar vaqt o'tishi bilan ko'payadi. Uyda ovqat tayyorlash uzoq muddatda ancha tejamliroqdir.

Bundan tashqari, tez ovqatdan voz kechish odamlarni ovqat tayyorlash mahoratini rivojlantirishga va ular nima yeyayotgani haqida ko'proq ongli tanlov qilishga undaydi. Bu yangi masalliqlar va muvozanatli ovqatlanishni yanada qadrlashga olib kelishi mumkin.

Nihoyat, atrof-muhitga ta'siri ham bor. Tez ovqatlanish tarmoqlari qadoqlash chiqindilari va sanoat dehqonchiligiga hissa qo'shadi. Ulardan voz kechish orqali biz sayyoramiz uchun o'z hissamizni qo'shishimiz mumkin.

questions.sampleAnswer:
There are several reasons why people often choose unhealthy food over nutritious alternatives.
Firstly, convenience plays a major role. In today's fast-paced world, many people simply don't have the time to cook. Fast food is quick, readily available, and requires no preparation. After a long day at work, it's tempting to just grab something on the way home.
Secondly, unhealthy food is specifically designed to taste good. Companies spend millions on research to create addictive flavors that trigger pleasure centers in our brains. The combination of salt, sugar, and fat is incredibly satisfying to our taste buds.
Additionally, there's the social aspect. As we can see in the picture, eating fast food is often a social activity. Friends gathering for burgers or pizza is a common way to bond and socialize.
Finally, cost can be a factor. While home cooking is cheaper in the long term, fast food often seems more affordable upfront, especially for those on tight budgets. Unfortunately, the hidden costs to health are much greater.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Odamlarning ko'pincha sog'lom oziq-ovqat o'rniga zararli ovqatni tanlashining bir nechta sabablari bor.

Birinchidan, qulaylik katta rol o'ynaydi. Bugungi tez sur'atlar bilan rivojlanayotgan dunyoda ko'p odamlarning ovqat tayyorlashga vaqti yo'q. Fast-fud tez, oson topiladi va hech qanday tayyorgarlikni talab qilmaydi. Ishda uzoq kundan so'ng, uyga ketayotganda shunchaki bir narsa olib ketish vasvasaga soladi.

Ikkinchidan, zararli ovqat aynan yaxshi ta'mga ega bo'lish uchun yaratilgan. Kompaniyalar miyamizdagi zavq markazlarini qo'zg'atadigan o'rganib qoladigan ta'mlarni yaratish uchun millionlab mablag' sarflaydilar. Tuz, shakar va yog'ning kombinatsiyasi ta'm bilishimiz uchun juda yoqimli.

Bundan tashqari, ijtimoiy jihat ham bor. Rasmda ko'rib turganimizdek, fast-fud yeyish ko'pincha ijtimoiy faoliyat hisoblanadi. Do'stlar burger yoki pizza uchun yig'ilishlari - bu aloqa o'rnatish va muloqot qilishning keng tarqalgan usuli.

Nihoyat, narx omil bo'lishi mumkin. Uyda ovqat tayyorlash uzoq muddatda arzonroq bo'lsa-da, fast-fud ko'pincha oldindan arzonroq ko'rinadi, ayniqsa, byudjeti cheklanganlar uchun. Afsuski, sog'liq uchun yashirin xarajatlar ancha yuqori.

questions.prompt: Tell me about something you did in your life that was a success.
questions.sampleA1: I play football. I win. I am happy.
questions.sampleA2: I cooked dinner. It was pasta. My family liked it and I was happy because it tasted good.
questions.sampleB1: I think a big success was when I learned to drive. It was difficult at first, but I practiced a lot. Now I can go anywhere I want, and it makes my life much easier. Also, my parents are happy that I can drive them places.
questions.sampleB2: Well, one thing I'm genuinely proud of was passing my driving test, which might sound small, but for me it was a real milestone. To be honest, I struggled with it at first — I actually failed on my first attempt, which knocked my confidence quite a bit. But rather than throwing in the towel, I knuckled down, booked extra lessons, and practised every single weekend until things finally clicked. The impact on my life was huge. All of a sudden, I had this newfound independence — I could nip to the shops, drive myself to work, and stop relying on other people for lifts. It made a world of difference to my everyday routine. What's more, it took a weight off my parents' shoulders, because now I can run errands for them and even ferry my younger sister to college. So in a way, the whole family benefited. As for hard work, talent, and opportunity, I'd say all three go hand in hand, but if I'm honest, hard work matters most. I'm not a naturally gifted driver by any stretch, so I had to put in the hours to get up to scratch. Talent might give you a bit of a head start, but without graft it only gets you so far. And opportunity plays its part too — I was lucky enough to have a patient instructor and a family car to practise in, which not everyone has. At the end of the day, I firmly believe that success boils down to sheer persistence more than anything else.

Barcha ko'ngillilarni muvofiqlashtirish va mablag'ni ta'minlash juda qiyin edi, lekin biz mahalliy hayvonlar boshpanasi uchun katta miqdorda pul yig'ishga muvaffaq bo'ldik. Tadbir juda muvaffaqiyatli o'tdi va bunday arzirli ishga hissa qo'shganimdan juda xursand bo'ldim. Ushbu tajriba orqali men yetakchilik va jamoada ishlash haqida ko'p narsa o'rgandim.

bulletPoints: Tell me about something you did in your life that was a success.
How did this success impact your life and the people around you?
What role do hard work, talent, and opportunity play in achieving success?
questions.sampleAnswer:
One of my most significant achievements was passing my English proficiency exam with a high score, which opened doors to international opportunities.
This success required months of dedicated preparation. I spent countless hours studying vocabulary, practicing speaking, and completing mock tests. It wasn't easy, and there were moments when I wanted to give up, but I pushed through because I knew how important it was for my future.
The impact on my life was profound. It boosted my confidence tremendously and proved that I could achieve ambitious goals through persistent effort. My family was incredibly proud, and it inspired my younger siblings to take their studies more seriously.
Regarding the factors of success, I believe all three elements – hard work, talent, and opportunity – are equally important. Hard work is the foundation; without dedication, even the most talented person will struggle. Talent gives you an advantage, but it must be developed through practice. Finally, opportunity is crucial – being in the right place at the right time can make all the difference. As they say, "Success is where preparation meets opportunity."
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Mening eng muhim yutuqlarimdan biri ingliz tili bo'yicha imtihonimni yuqori ball bilan topshirganim bo'ldi, bu esa xalqaro imkoniyatlar eshiklarini ochdi.

Bu muvaffaqiyat oylar davomida tinimsiz tayyorgarlikni talab qildi. Men lug'at yodlash, gapirish amaliyotini bajarish va sinov imtihonlarini topshirishga son-sanoqsiz soatlar sarfladim. Bu oson bo'lmadi va men taslim bo'lishni xohlagan paytlarim ham bo'ldi, lekin men o'z kelajagim uchun bu qanchalik muhimligini bilganim uchun o'zimni majburladim.

Buning hayotimga ta'siri juda katta bo'ldi. Bu mening o'z-o'ziga ishonchimni juda oshirdi va qat'iyatli harakatlar orqali ulkan maqsadlarga erisha olishimni isbotladi. Mening oilam juda faxrlanishdi va bu mening ukalarimni o'qishga jiddiyroq qarashga ilhomlantirdi.

Muvaffaqiyat omillariga kelsak, menimcha, uchta element ham - mehnat, iste'dod va imkoniyat - teng darajada muhim. Mehnat - bu asos; fidoyiliksiz hatto eng iste'dodli odam ham qiynaladi. Iste'dod sizga ustunlik beradi, lekin uni mashq qilish orqali rivojlantirish kerak. Nihoyat, imkoniyat juda muhim - kerakli vaqtda kerakli joyda bo'lish katta farq qilishi mumkin. Aytishlaricha, "Muvaffaqiyat - bu tayyorgarlik imkoniyat bilan uchrashadigan joydir."

questions.prompt: Books Are Better than Movies for Storytelling
questions.sampleA1: I like books. Books good. Movies, um, okay. But books, yes.
questions.sampleA2: I like books more. Because books have more story. Movies are short. But books, I like to read and imagine. And books are quiet.
questions.sampleB1: I think books are better than movies. Because in books, you can read more details about the characters and the story. For example, you can know what the characters are thinking. In movies, you only see what they do. However, movies are more exciting sometimes because you can see everything.
questions.sampleB2: This is a really interesting topic, and honestly, opinions are pretty divided on it. On the one hand, I can see why people argue that books are better for storytelling. The thing is, a novel gives the author room to delve into a character's innermost thoughts and motivations in a way that a two-hour film simply can't. When you're reading, you're actively picturing everything in your mind's eye, so the story becomes uniquely yours. No two readers imagine the same scene in exactly the same way, and there's something magical about that. On the other hand, I wouldn't write off movies just yet. Films bring stories to life with stunning visuals, music, and brilliant acting, all of which can pack an emotional punch that words on a page sometimes struggle to match. What's more, they're far more accessible — you can sit down and enjoy a film in one evening, whereas ploughing through a thick novel can take weeks. There's also the shared experience of watching something with friends, which reading can't really replicate. That said, if I had to nail my colours to the mast, I'd side with books. For me, the depth of character and the sheer freedom to use my own imagination win hands down every time. A good book stays with you long after you've turned the final page. At the end of the day, though, I reckon it's not really a competition — the two mediums complement each other, and the best stories often work brilliantly in both forms.
questions.uzSampleA1: Menga kitoblar yoqadi. Kitoblar yaxshi. Kinolar, hmm, mayli. Lekin kitoblar, ha.
questions.uzSampleA2: Menga kitoblar ko'proq yoqadi. Chunki kitoblarda hikoya ko'proq bo'ladi. Kinolar qisqa bo'ladi. Lekin kitoblar, men o'qishni va tasavvur qilishni yaxshi ko'raman. Va kitoblar sokin.
questions.uzSampleB1: Menimcha, kitoblar hikoya aytish uchun filmlardan yaxshiroq. Chunki kitoblarda siz qahramonlar va hikoya haqida ko'proq ma'lumot o'qishingiz mumkin. Masalan, siz qahramonlar nima o'ylayotganini bilishingiz mumkin. Filmlarda esa, siz faqat ularning nima qilayotganini ko'rasiz. Biroq, filmlar ba'zan qiziqarliroq bo'ladi, chunki siz hamma narsani ko'rishingiz mumkin.
questions.uzSampleB2:
Men kitoblar filmlarga nisbatan hikoya qilishda ustunroq tajriba taklif etadi deb o'ylashga moyilman. Kitoblar qahramonlarning fikrlari va motivlariga chuqurroq kirishga imkon beradi, bu ko'pincha filmni vizual tarjima qilishda yo'qoladi. Shuningdek, o'qish sizning tasavvuringizni film tomosha qilishda bo'lmagan tarzda jalb qiladi; siz faol ravishda dunyoni va qahramonlarni o'z ongizda yaratasiz.
Biroq, filmlar yanada qulay va vizual ta'sirchan bo'lishi mumkin, hikoyalarni kengroq auditoriya uchun jonlantiradi va umumiy tajribani taklif qiladi.
Oxir-oqibat, ikkala vositaning ham o'z afzalliklari bor, lekin men kitoblar taqdim etadigan chuqurlik va tasavvur erkinligini qadrlayman.

questions.sampleAnswer:
The debate over whether books are better than movies for storytelling is genuinely fascinating, and I'd like to explore both perspectives.
On the one hand, there are compelling arguments in favor of books. Firstly, books provide significantly more detail and depth. Authors can spend pages describing characters' inner thoughts and motivations, something that's incredibly difficult to capture on screen. Additionally, reading encourages imagination and creativity – when you read a book, you create your own mental images of the characters and settings. This makes the experience deeply personal. Furthermore, books allow for personal interpretation; two readers can have entirely different experiences with the same story.
On the other hand, movies have their own advantages. They can visually bring stories to life in ways that books cannot. The combination of stunning visuals, music, and acting creates an immersive experience. Movies are also quicker and more accessible – you can enjoy a complete story in two hours rather than spending weeks reading. Moreover, movies are easier to share and discuss with others, making them more of a social experience.
In my opinion, both mediums have their strengths. Books offer depth and imagination, while movies provide visual spectacle and accessibility. Ultimately, the best storytelling depends on the story being told and the audience experiencing it.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Hikoyalar aytish uchun kitoblar filmlardan yaxshiroqmi degan bahs juda qiziqarli va men har ikki nuqtai nazarni ham o'rganmoqchiman.

Bir tomondan, kitoblarni qo'llab-quvvatlovchi ishonchli dalillar mavjud. Birinchidan, kitoblar ancha batafsil va chuqur ma'lumot beradi. Mualliflar qahramonlarning ichki fikrlari va motivlarini tasvirlash uchun sahifalar sarflashlari mumkin, buni ekranda aks ettirish juda qiyin. Bundan tashqari, o'qish tasavvur va ijodkorlikni rag'batlantiradi – kitob o'qiganingizda, siz qahramonlar va voqealar joylarining o'z shaxsiy tasvirlaringizni yaratasiz. Bu esa tajribani juda shaxsiy qiladi. Bundan tashqari, kitoblar shaxsiy talqin qilish imkoniyatini beradi; ikki o'quvchi bir xil hikoya bilan butunlay boshqacha tajribaga ega bo'lishi mumkin.

Boshqa tomondan, filmlarning o'z afzalliklari bor. Ular hikoyalarni kitoblar qila olmaydigan tarzda vizual tarzda jonlantirishi mumkin. Ajoyib vizual effektlar, musiqa va aktyorlik kombinatsiyasi immersiv tajriba yaratadi. Filmlar ham tezroq va osonroq – siz haftalar davomida o'qish o'rniga ikki soat ichida to'liq hikoyadan bahramand bo'lishingiz mumkin. Bundan tashqari, filmlarni boshqalar bilan baham ko'rish va muhokama qilish osonroq, bu ularni ko'proq ijtimoiy tajribaga aylantiradi.

Mening fikrimcha, har ikki vositaning ham o'z kuchli tomonlari bor. Kitoblar chuqurlik va tasavvurni taklif qilsa, filmlar vizual tomosha va qulaylikni ta'minlaydi. Oxir oqibat, eng yaxshi hikoya aytish hikoyaning o'zi va uni boshdan kechirayotgan tomoshabinga bog'liq.
